sources.title: The digital reinvention of an Asian bank: interview and biography
sources.findings: Biography gives 24 January 1960, Meerut; Citi periods 1982–2000 and 2001–09. Interview discusses customer journeys and experimentation.
sources.caution: Read biography and adjacent interview sections only. Its MBA shorthand is superseded by precise PGDM title in current Keppel biography. CEO title is historical; no uninterrupted 27-year Citi tenure asserted.

sources.title: Current board: Piyush Gupta
sources.findings: Chairman and independent non-executive director; BA Honours Economics St Stephens/Delhi; PG Diploma in Management IIM Ahmedabad.
sources.caution: Not Keppel CEO, which is Loh Chin Hua. Do not copy other directors degrees or conflate diploma with MBA.

sources.title: 2009 annual report: director biography
sources.caution: Read Gupta entry only, not full annual report. September announcement subject to approval is not effective date.

sources.title: 28 March 2025 AGM outcome
sources.findings: Confirms Gupta retired at AGM conclusion; identifies separate cessation notice as executive director and CEO.
sources.caution: March 6 filing differs from March 28 retirement; avoid treating earlier future retirement announcement as completed event.

sources.title: 30 November 2020: LVB amalgamation
sources.findings: Government/RBI statutory scheme effective 27 November 2020, amalgamating LVB with DBS Bank India.
sources.caution: November 30 is release date, November 17 was proposal. Not personal purchase or an ordinary voluntary share acquisition.

sources.title: 1 November 2023: six-month pause on DBS activities
sources.findings: After repeated disruptions, MAS paused nonessential IT changes and restricted new business acquisitions and shrinking Singapore branch/ATM network.
sources.caution: Historical six-month bank restrictions, not personal criminal finding or permanent ban. No claim restrictions still operate in 2026.

sources.title: Deputy board chairman appointment
sources.findings: Deputy chair and independent nonexecutive director effective 1 July 2025; education wording confirmed.
sources.caution: Announcement and effective date differ; not chairman from July 2025.

sources.title: 17 April 2026 AGM results
sources.findings: Re-election passed; succeeds Danny Teoh as chairman effective 17 April 2026.
sources.caution: February announcement was prospective; actual AGM result confirms transition. Historical deputy chair on attendance sheet reflects before handover.

sources.title: 2 June 2026: Council of Presidential Advisers appointments
sources.findings: Gupta member effective 2 June 2026 on Chief Justice advice; previously alternate from August 2025.
sources.caution: Not Council chairman or elected legislator. Page image/caption is Tan Chong Meng ceremony, not proof Gupta attended.

sources.title: 17 April 2026 AGM minutes: attendance
sources.findings: Opening attendance explicitly lists Gupta present as deputy chair alongside outgoing chair Teoh.
sources.caution: Read opening/attendance, not all 16 pages; management remarks belong to CEO Loh, not Gupta.

sources.title: Profile on announced DBS retirement
sources.findings: Born in India in 1960; became Singapore citizen shortly after joining as DBS CEO.
sources.caution: Historical 2024 article announces future retirement; use 2025 AGM outcome for completion. No exact naturalization day asserted.
